title: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway Owns Zero Pure-Play AI Stocks. But This 2016 Acquisition Gives It Exposure to the Data Center Boom.
title_zh: 沃伦·巴菲特的伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司拥有零只纯人工智能股票。但 2016 年的这次收购使其暴露在数据中心热潮中。
summary: A Berkshire acquisition from 10 years ago gives the Oracle of Omaha's conglomerate exposure to the data center proliferation trend.
summary_zh: 伯克希尔哈撒韦公司十年前的收购让这家奥马哈甲骨文集团接触到了数据中心激增的趋势。

title: AMD just landed its biggest AI deal yet
title_zh: AMD 刚刚达成迄今为止最大的人工智能交易
summary: AMD has broken a chip monopoly before. In the 2000s, it took server market share away from Intel’s dominant x86 processors, forcing years of price and performance competition that reshaped enterprise computing.
summary_zh: AMD此前曾打破过芯片垄断。在 2000 年代，它从英特尔占主导地位的 x86 处理器手中夺走了服务器市场份额，迫使人们进行多年的价格和性能竞争，从而重塑了企业计算。

title: BlackRock Launches $12 Billion+ Meta Data Center Debt Deal
title_zh: 贝莱德启动超过 120 亿美元的元数据中心债务交易
summary: BlackRock combines GIP and HPS to finance Meta's AI data center project through a major bond sale.
summary_zh: 贝莱德将 GIP 和 HPS 结合起来，通过一次大型债券销售为 Meta 的人工智能数据中心项目提供资金。

title: Blackstone Backs Futronic in Deal Valuing Robotics Supplier at $675 Million
title_zh: Blackstone 在机器人供应商交易中支持 Futronic，估值达 6.75 亿美元
summary: Private equity investment supports Futronic's global expansion as Blackstone highlights AI, robotics and automotive growth opportunities.
summary_zh: Blackstone 强调人工智能、机器人和汽车增长机会，私募股权投资支持 Futronic 的全球扩张。
